5.name: Episode 1
5.overview: New singles looking for love reach Inferno and find a fast track to Paradise. Couples fly out, others are left behind — but a twist waits for them.

5.name: Episode 2
5.overview: Stranded singles spark instant chemistry over a meal. As couples return from Paradise, a dodgeball match reshuffles picks — and new bonds start to form.

5.name: Episode 3
5.overview: As fresh connections emerge, a photo shoot challenge begins. The women choose partners — one may even pick two — forming bold pairs. Who wins the prize?

5.name: Episode 4
5.overview: A tricky double pick stirs tension among the singles. Later, campfire confessions send mixed signals, scrambling already tangled lines.

5.name: Episode 5
5.overview: Sparks turn serious for several singles. Two new singles arrive and race through speedy one-on-one dates — each choosing two for a Paradise escape.

5.name: Episode 6
5.overview: The men clash in a bruising power-and-grit challenge for a hard-won dinner date, with only two claiming top spot — who'll earn the meal and make it real?

5.name: Episode 7
5.overview: Flirting goes full throttle as the singles make moves to lock in their bond. Later, an endurance balance game tests couples — especially one team.

5.name: Episode 8
5.overview: It's time for a Paradise retreat, and Choi Mina Sue's bold pick stuns everyone. With her heart in constant motion, will she now stand firm — or sway?

5.name: Episode 9
5.overview: Couples return from Paradise, and one single confronts a rival over a stolen connection. Later, a splashy showdown rewards three women with another trip.

5.name: Episode 10
5.overview: Paradise brings stronger bonds; Inferno sees a new love triangle. Then a men's tug-of-war match decides the final ticket to Paradise — who takes it?

5.name: Episode 11
5.overview: With everyone together in Inferno, singles speak openly and seal connections. By a final campfire, they share confessions as decisions come into focus.

5.name: Episode 12
5.overview: The final days in Inferno arrive. Last chances, clear choices and full hearts collide — who will walk off the island as a couple, and who will walk alone?

lastEpisodeToAir.name: Episode 12
lastEpisodeToAir.overview: The final days in Inferno arrive. Last chances, clear choices and full hearts collide — who will walk off the island as a couple, and who will walk alone?

overview: On a deserted island, flirtatious singles look for love, because only as a couple can they leave the island for a romantic date in paradise.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Singles stranded on a deserted island. Only couples can escape the hot inferno. Who will end up in paradise?

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The gates of Single's Inferno are open again! Get caught up in the excitement and tension of an all new group. Where one decision can change everything. The hottest inferno returns for another winter.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Stranded and ready to mingle, flirty singles search for love on a deserted island they can only escape as couples for romantic date nights in paradise.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: It brings the hottest, flirtiest singles to a deserted island, where the only way to escape is to find true romance and spend a romantic night in "paradise".

tagline: A romantic and exciting dating reality show that follows 10 men and women trapped on a hot deserted island.
title: Single's Inferno
